title: Pair machine
intro: Generate a 6-digit code on the PC and enter it here. It is valid for 5 minutes.
introTailscale: Sign in without a code using your Tailscale account, or use a 6-digit code generated on the PC.

errors.invalidInput: Check the address, the code (6 digits) and the device name.
errors.addressScheme: The address must start with http:// or https://.
errors.https: Use https:// in the PC address (e.g. https://pc-office.your-tailnet.ts.net). http:// is only allowed for localhost, 127.0.0.1 or this app's own origin.
errors.tailscaleUnavailable: Signing in with Tailscale is not enabled for this account on this PC. Use a pairing code.
